issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, so IDs containing slashes or reserved characters hit the wrong endpoint.
Transient httpx transport failures are neither retried nor wrapped in LumenAPIError, so network outages bypass the client error model.
batch_create eagerly materializes the entire iterable before chunking, which can exhaust memory or hang on large/infinite iterables.
batch_create silently drops malformed result entries and can return fewer results than submitted tasks without raising.
Paginated list methods treat missing or malformed items arrays as successful empty/partial responses, masking API contract failures.
Task inherits from TaskCreate, so passing a fetched Task into batch_create serializes server-owned id/state fields into a create request.
Model parsers coerce invalid/null values and do not validate Literal fields, weakening the guarantees expected from a typed client.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores the standard HTTP-date form, causing incorrect retry timing.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading 'request was not attempted' runtime error.
